parameters.name: ApplyId
parameters.description:
The application batch ID that you want to query.

The application batch ID is returned after you successfully call the [BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~) or [BatchRegisterDevice](~~69473~~) operation.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter has no value, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices you want to query belong.
